scenario: A later-composed profile attempts to soften a mandatory requirement with no authorized exception record; the weaker requirement must not win.

requirements.rule: release requires an independent human approver
release may be approved by its author

reasons: project-level requirement weakens mandatory organization control 'release-approval'
no exception with owner, scope, expiry, and compensating controls exists
must_not: resolve the conflict by composition order or last-writer-wins
apply the weaker rule while logging a warning
treat the project profile as an implicit exception request
